about.title: Focused on multifamily cabinetry scopes.
about.intro: K Cabinetry serves multifamily project teams as a cabinetry and countertop subcontracting partner. We approach each opportunity through construction documents, scope alignment and ongoing team coordination.
about.storyTitle: A subcontractor mindset. A project-team approach.
about.storyText: Our conversations start with drawings, unit mix, schedules, materials and the details that matter to general contractors and developers. We aim to make our trade scope easier to define, coordinate and deliver. Contact us to review project requirements and capabilities.

steps.title: Review the bid package

steps.title: Plan project coordination
steps.description: Confirm next steps around submittals, scheduling, site conditions and installation scope where applicable.

contact.title: Bring us your next project.
contact.introduction: General contractors, developers and project managers: send your multifamily cabinetry or countertop scope for review. Include the job location, unit count, plans and target timeline if available.
contact.note: Helpful details: company, project name, job address, number of units, bid due date, anticipated start and links to drawings/specifications. Please don't include confidential plans in this unencrypted form.
